name: Mirrored Damage
description: In response to being damaged by a creature it can see within 120 feet of itself, the creature forces that creature to make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 24 (8d6) force damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.
